train_augmentation: original GpuPipeSeg geometry and photometric, ImageNet normalization; color_jitter=.10, photo_strength=1
checkpoint_selection: last epoch60 only; outer held-out data never selects parameters, epoch, threshold or run
split: five contiguous timestamp blocks, round(i*N/5) bounds; purge training timestamps within2s of held-out interval
initialization_rule: same ImageNet + exactly shared initial encoder/decoder for all arms, shared matching plain/attention tensors; reset seed42 for each fold/arm
execution: channels_last for all groups, CUDA AMP; fused Adam, identical formula/hyperparameters for all groups
evaluation: all held-out images, including empty GT; argmax; boundary F1 tolerance2px
report: five-fold unweighted mean +/- sample std(ddof1); sample variance also saved; pooled out-of-fold scores separate
limits: Folds measure temporal partition variability; not five-seed variance on a fixed split
Only one source sequence; no independent site/voyage generalization claim
Training folds overlap; no unqualified significance claim from five correlated fold results
